description: Metadata for confirmed public Allen Institute for AI pages about AI safety or AI research on allenai.org. Each URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights label. Page text is not stored. Rights is creative_commons only when the page states a CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA reuse licence. CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, and CC BY-NC-ND stay unknown. A missing publication date stays unknown. Not every Ai2 page is listed. This catalog is not a belief collector.
